object_description: small-footprint polygonal building with an organically composed form
design_condition: The compact polygonal building is placed at the southern tip and embedded in the slope, preserving the tree frame and creating three differentiated outdoor spaces at different levels while retaining the kindergarten’s views and qualities.

positive.statement: The placement creates generous open spaces at different height levels and preserves the valuable trees.
The three outdoor spaces are differentiated and easily usable, with sunny and shady areas.
The kindergarten retains its external qualities and view through the clever positioning of the new building.
The central-cloakroom organization is efficient and logical, with high functionality and good visual relationships.
The organically composed form responds to the special use and contrasts attractively with the orthogonal context.
The care rooms offer varied usage scenarios, beautiful proportions, and good lighting.
The kitchen and sanitary facilities are well thought out and ideally arranged.

negative.statement: The ramp’s proximity to the existing kindergarten building is problematic.
The access from Gotthelfstrasse is spacious but somewhat complex.
Moisture carried through the cloakrooms can reach all areas in wet weather.
The lower cloakrooms receive little daylight and may require artificial light all day.
The multi-purpose room is significantly smaller than the required area.
The dark vertical facade differs too much from the structural context.
The open attached staircase raises questions about performance in winter weather with snow and ice.
